title: Expectation of a basis function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $\pi$, and let $\{\phi_a:a\in\iota\}$ be a finite orthonormal basis of real functions on $\Omega$ in the $\pi$-weighted inner product, with $\phi_0$ the constant function $1$. For every basis index $a$, the expectation of $\phi_a$ under $\pi$ is $1$ if $a=0$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: probability measure on the sample space
orthonormal real-function basis with a constant-one basis vector
